newsitem.title: USA: TVA launches counterattack on lawmakers, utilities.
newsitem.headline: TVA launches counterattack on lawmakers, utilities.

text.p: The Tennessee Valley Authority Tuesday asked House lawmakers to investigate tax breaks enjoyed by investor-owned utilities, in a battle to win the sympathies of lawmakers who must decide how to treat public utilities if power markets are opened to competition.
TVA, a government-owned corporation that other utilities consider to be heavily subsidized, said investor-owned utilities received tax breaks worth more than $100 billion.
At the same time, in a letter to two lawmakers, TVA Chairman Craven Crowell disputed claims that TVA received $1.2 billion annually in federal subsidies.
